properties.organization: FISHTOWN KENSINGTON AREA BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTRICT

properties.notes: The North Broad Renaissance service area extends north on Broad Street, beyond the improvement district boundary, to Butler Street. These services are are funded through PHL Taking Care of Business Clean Corridors program funds among other funding sources

This district is funded through voluntary contributions by property owners and institutions within the district's boundaries. Property owners are not required by City ordinance to pay assessment fees to the improvement district.
